A typical **medium-sized fresh tomato** (about 120–130 grams) contains roughly **20–23 kilocalories**—so around **21 kcal on average**.  

If you’re looking at smaller cherry tomatoes they’ll have fewer calories overall because each one weighs only a few grams, whereas larger beefsteak varieties may push toward the upper end of that range.
